title: Optimizing edge weights in the inverse eigenvector centrality problem
summary: In this paper we study the inverse eigenvector centrality problem on directed graphs: given a prescribed node centrality profile, we seek edge weights that realize it. Since this inverse problem generally admits infinitely many solutions, we explicitly characterize the feasible set of admissible weights and introduce six optimization problems defined over this set, each corresponding to a different weight-selection strategy.
